claims.claim: The Ai Pin is priced at $700.
There is a $24 monthly subscription required to use the device on the Humane network, which is powered by T-Mobile.
Orders for the Ai Pin are set to begin in the United States on November 16.
The Ai Pin has a built-in 13-megapixel ultra wide-angle camera.
The Ai Pin uses a Qualcomm Snapdragon chip to power it.
The Ai Pin has cellular connectivity and can be used to answer phone calls from trusted contacts.

delta: no traditional display, uses hand-projected laser interface
hot-swappable battery system for continuous use
AI-first interface with no apps, all functions via voice and gesture
